directorSuppliedVisualEvidence.resolution: Multi-angle inspection disproves the earlier asymmetry claim: the round printed dish is centered behind the rider; the compact printed control panel is in front of the rider, not a second rear-side module. The two runners and orange grilles form a laterally paired layout. The apparent offset in the low-resolution instruction crop is perspective.

crossChecks.use: Official instruction source and model identity.

Duplicate-family cross-check; not an additional design donor.

verifiedSourceFeatures: Two long, parallel forward runners with blunt separated ends.
Open central deck with one exposed rider.
A round printed dish centered behind the rider and a separate compact printed control panel in front of the rider; they are not a left/right pair.
evidenceLimits: Director-supplied stills resolve front, side, rear and overhead symmetry; source video URL was not included, so the screenshots are retained as supplied references.
The static instructions do not verify propulsion, underside lift, or a separate mechanical hover mechanism.
